notes: Lofty Denial, printed: 'If YOU control a creature with flying, counter that spell unless its controller pays {4} instead.' The flier belongs to seat 0, the caster of the countered spell, not to Lofty Denial's controller (seat 1). So the tax is the base {1}: seat 0 pays one {R} (R 4 -> 3) and the Shieldmate resolves. A tax of {4} would have taken all four.
